title: "No More Invisible! Playful Infection Prevention for Kindergarten - Kids"
summary:
The main goal of the project is to improve knowledge about preventing infections among children and daycare staff, and to promote health education. To do this, a play kit will be developed together with children and educators, which can later be used in kindergartens, free of charge. The kit will teach children basic knowledge about infections and how to prevent them: What is an infection, how do they happen, and how can they be prevented?
Along with the play kit, additional materials will be created for daycare staff and institutions. These will include teaching tools for everyday use in daycare (e.g., topic cards, a collection of tips for conversation starters, and more). The project will also focus on providing practical advice for wound care (e.g., cleaning wounds) and explaining legal issues to help daycare staff feel more confident in their work.
